image_description: A high-angle shot of a public toilet with a white ceramic bowl and black seat. The toilet seat is covered in crumpled, translucent white paper (likely sanitary seat covers or toilet paper) arranged in a makeshift ring. Additional loose sheets of paper are scattered on the grey tiled floor to the left. A chrome flush pipe extends from the top center. The background features white subway tiles.
